addendum_content_raw:
Section VII, #1:  Value is based on the most current county property tax assessment (for tax year ending June 30, 2019).
Section VII, #2:  Age-based mandatory distribution.
Section VII, #5:  Combined college savings accounts in prior reports. This separates them into two accounts. Does not impact value. No reportable gain on this
 account because it was a qualified disbursement from college savings plan.
Section VII, ##8, 9:  The amendment dated 5-13-21 corrects an error in the 2019 report.  The IRA account in line 8 contained the Fidelity Total Market Index and
 the investment account in Line 9 contained the Fidelity 500 Index, not the other way around, as reported. The other reported information remains the same.
Section III-A:  The amendment dated 5-13-21 corrects the date from 2018 to 2019.
Section VII, ##7, 8, 9, 10: Changes were made in response to the Committee's February 1, 2022 letter to reflect the amount in each fund.  (Previously numbers 7
 and 8 were combined and numbers 9 and 10 were combined.)  These are widely held investment funds in that they widely diversified and one can neither exercise
 control over nor have the ability to exercise control over the financial interest held by the fund.
